record.dic_text:
06714 Tsochar {tso'-khar}

與 06713 同源 ; 陽性專有名詞

AV - Zoar 4, Jezoar 1; 5

瑣轄 = "黃褐色的"
1) 猶大人, 亞施戶和妻子希拉的兒子 (#代上 4:7|)
2) 赫人以弗崙的父親
3) 西緬的一個兒子
record.edic_text:
06714 Tsochar {tso'-khar}

from the same as 06713;; n pr m

AV - Zoar 4, Jezoar 1; 5

Zohar = "tawny"
1) a Judaite, son of Ashur by wife Helah
2) father of Ephron the Hittite
3) one of the sons of Simeon; also 'Zerah'
